newsitem.title: USA: Biomune to spin off Volu-Sol unit.
newsitem.headline: Biomune to spin off Volu-Sol unit.

text.p: Biomune Systems Inc said Tuesday it would spin off its Volu-Sol Inc unit to shareholders.
It said one common share of Volu-Sol will be issued for every 10 Biomune shares held as of March 5.
Volu-Sol will trade as a separate publicly-owned company when the spin-off is completed and a registration statement is declared effective by regulators, Biomune said.
Biomune President Milton Adair said the step was taken after careful evaluation and upon deciding that the two companies would have greater value as separate entities.
"We believe the separation...will allow each company to more clearly focus on its individual goals and objectives, thereby serving the best interest of shareholders," he said.
Volu-Sol manufactures medical stains for hospital and laboratory use. It recently launched a product, Definitive, that contains a proprietary micro-chip that regulates precise stain amounts.
Biomune is engaged in the development and commercialization of biologic pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.
